positions.commentary: Masterclass is compared to Netflix regarding social status and currency, suggesting it rivals Netflix in terms of social prestige.
The speaker cites Airbnb as an example of a company that had to adjust its business model when international and cross-country travel stopped early in the pandemic.
The speaker predicts that DoorDash will become one of the next big marketplace companies if it can persist with strong growth at scale.

thesis: The episode argues that marketplace startups face significant existential risks when external conditions change, citing Airbnb's forced pivot during the pandemic as a cautionary tale.
